conclusion: On the verified InlongSlicer build, X2 final layer Z=246.4 can contain no deposited motion under arc fitting at 0.01 mm resolution; disabling arc fitting or using 0.001 mm restores tiny extrusions. A reconstructed native contour collapses to two identical points under the actual library simplifier, while nonempty extrusion collections still schedule the layer. The slanted Vulcan600 training model fails with fully fresh Vulcan600 0.6/0.25 presets and with X600HD 0.6/0.25 presets. The organic independent layer planner can delete the optional first support anchor Z=0.25 when an exact contact Z=0.2875 is closer than its 0.05 mm minimum. Changing only top gap 0.2125 to 0.20 or 0.15 passes; zero first-layer XY gap alone does not. These are diagnosed, unfixed product defects; exit-code/log-only checks are not sufficient endpoint-path validation.
